;Business and economy
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]; [[Unemployment in the United States]]
**Over the last week, 4.4 million [[Americans]] filed for [[unemployment benefit]]s. Since mid-March, 26.4 million have filed, which is more than 15 percent of the workforce. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-52398837 (BBC News)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]]
**[[Ministry of Economic Development (Italy)|Italian Minister of Economic Development]] [[Stefano Patuanelli]] announces the government will [[Nationalization|nationalize]] the country's main [[flag carrier]] [[Alitalia]] by June, claiming the airline will go bankrupt otherwise. This reverses earlier plans to have it fully privatized. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-italy-alitalia/rome-to-take-full-control-of-alitalia-in-june-minister-idUSKCN2252XQ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Facebook]] removes "[[pseudoscience]]" and "[[conspiracy theory]]" as options for [[Targeted advertising|targeted ads]], as criticism mounts against [[social media]] for their role in [[Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic|spreading misinformation about the coronavirus]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-facebook-ads/facebook-gets-rid-of-pseudoscience-ad-targeting-category-idUSKCN2253CC?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****Fifty crew members on the cruise ship ''[[Costa Atlantica]]'' test positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] after it docks in [[Nagasaki]], [[Japan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-japan-ship/italian-cruise-ship-in-japan-has-48-coronavirus-cases-idUSKCN22504S?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Two former high-ranking members of the [[Syrian Army]] go on trial in [[Koblenz]], [[Rhineland-Palatinate]], [[Germany]], for alleged [[war crime]]s committed during the [[Syrian Civil War]]. This is the first time that Syrian military officials are being prosecuted for their roles in the conflict. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/world-syria-torture-trial-opens-germany-200423081540338.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-germany/german-court-opens-first-syria-torture-trial-idUSKCN22525P?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Kiribati parliamentary election]]
**Results show that four women win seats in the parliament and that most ministers of the current [[government of Kiribati|government]] keep their seats, including [[President of Kiribati|President]] [[Taneti Mamau]]. However, it is too early to say whether he would be his party's nomination for President again. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/414955/fourteen-new-mps-elected-in-kiribati (RNZ)]
*[[Lesotho]] [[Prime Minister of Lesotho|Prime Minister]] [[Tom Thabane]] rejects a deal between South African mediators and his [[coalition government]] asking him to resign amid accusations that he was involved in the [[murder]] of his ex-wife. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-pm-shows-no-signs-of-leaving-to-defuse-crisis-idUSKCN225330?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2020 NFL season]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**In [[American football]], the [[National Football League]] starts its [[2020 NFL Draft|draft]] for the 2020 season, with the [[Cincinnati Bengals]] selecting [[Joe Burrow]] with the [[List of first overall National Football League draft picks|first]] overall pick. The draft's public events in [[Las Vegas]] were canceled, with teams selecting players from private offices to comply with [[social distancing]] guidelines. [http://www.nfl.com/news/story/0ap3000001110800/article/cincinnati-bengals-pick-joe-burrow-no-1-in-2020-draft (NFL)]
